environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. ALB is configured with a standard HTTPS listener (ACM certificate) forwarding to target group on port 8080. No WAF attached. MongoDB Atlas M10 cluster with network access allowed from VPC CIDR. Application uses connection string with readWrite role on productdb. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to ECS tasks on 8080.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM cert, default action forward to TG
